runtime: OpenJDK 25.0.5 (Temurin-25.0.5+8) linux/arm64, the project base image

no_api_findings.finding: No exported java.* or jdk.* package provides a JSON parser.
no_api_findings.evidence: In the project image, `java --describe-module` over every module in `java --list-modules` exports no package whose name contains json, and no module name contains json.

no_api_findings.finding: Classes with json in their path exist only in non-exported packages: java.base jdk.internal.vm, jdk.javadoc internal doclets toolkit util, and jdk.jfr internal tool. These are internal writers/printers, not a supported parsing API, and were not treated as standard APIs.
no_api_findings.evidence: jrt:/ walk of /modules in the project image

no_api_findings.finding: Specification APIs outside Java SE; implementations (org.eclipse.parsson:parsson, org.glassfish:jakarta.json) ship as Maven artifacts and are logged as third-party leads.
Nashorn (JSON.parse via javax.script) was removed in JDK 15 and is absent from JDK 25.

limit: Inventory covers one OpenJDK 25.0.5 runtime image. Other vendors' JDKs or future JDK releases may add an API; that is not checked here.
